change: Persistent and slightly more compact Vim shortcut menu
behavior: Choosing a Neovim shortcut keeps its popup, group and page open. Outside taps dismiss it; Back does not dismiss it. Customize opens settings and closes the popup, and existing pane/control safety resets remain.
